regimeSub: Warsh hike threat crystallizes as markets price September action while BOK divergence and weak US data persist.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole (Aug 28) hike signal now priced by markets per CNBC (Aug 31) → DXY weakens to 99.5 as rate hike uncertainty meets soft landing doubts, 10Y holds 4.73%
BOK Governor Shin's explicit Fed decoupling statement (Aug 31 Businesskorea) after back-to-back hikes to 3.00% → KRW firms to 1370 as Korean President cites 3.5% terminal rate, bond tensions rise
US stagflation data locked: 1.5% GDP, 3.3% CPI, July NFP -23k, retail sales 'largest drop in more than a year' per ABC (Aug 14) → ING confirms spending stalls while PCE makes 'slow progress'
Memory sector pressure persists: Samsung/SK Hynix/Kioxia drop (TradingKey Aug 28) despite TSMC capex upgrade → KOSPI 6795 recovers modestly but HBM valuation reset continues post-Nvidia

headline: Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole hike threat now priced for September as stagflation data hardens (1.5% GDP, 3.3% CPI) while BOK Governor Shin explicitly decouples Korean policy from Fed guidance.
